item.title: Black hole sun/Won't you come/And wash away the rain
item.description: So basically, a key mission of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) was to provide a way of looking so far away that, given the time it takes for light to travel the distance, would be like looking at the earliest moments of the universe. Imagine their surprise when they discovered myriad "red dots." They couldn't figure those things out! But now it seems as if they're an entirely new type of astronomical phenomenon they're calling a "black hole star". The way a star works is that nuclear fusion creates the heat and light that we see. This isn't the case of a black hole star, though. Instead, a black hole is surrounded by a vast, incredibly dense cloud of gas. The force of the black hole's gravity pulls in that gas with such force that it causes it to glow a bright red. Like, literally, when they look at this thing with a spectrograph, it doesn't emit other colours. Just a very wild, very cool discovery. Yeah! Science, bitch! https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/aug/12/astronomy-discovery-new-cosmic-object-black-hole-star

item.description: Trump has been lying about who pays for his White House makeover since before he broke ground. He said dozens of times that private donations would fund the construction. Most of us grew tired of hearing about the ballroom months ago, but he kept spending until an appeals court ordered construction stopped last week. The $927 million he plans to spend covers only the mansion and grounds. The arch, the gold-leafed statues, and the public golf course he took over are all on separate tabs.
